## Checklist
- [ ] Branch is named `feat/*`, `fix/*`, `chore/*`, `docs/*` or `perf/*`; commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `python scripts/dev.py test` and `python scripts/dev.py lint` pass locally
- [ ] Added/updated tests (and the fixture/replay data if LLM behavior changed)
- [ ] Results are labelled **simulated** vs **real** honestly (no mock output presented as real EDA)
- [ ] Docs / README / CHANGELOG updated if user-visible
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, personal paths or model weights committed
